small_guidance: The correctness failure likely stems from TritonLinear precomputing weight_t at __init__ but the lm_head in GPT-2 shares weights with the token embedding — cloning weight.t() into a buffer breaks the tied-weight invariant if embeddings are updated, and more importantly the .t().contiguous() may be capturing stale/incorrect data. Drop the weight_t buffer and instead pass weight directly to triton_gemm with adjusted strides (b_stride args swapped) so the GEMM reads W^T on the fly. Also verify the Conv1D path: HF's Conv1D stores weight as (in, out) so x @ weight is correct — double-check stride args. Keep current autotune configs.
large_guidance: Redesign so TritonLinear and TritonConv1D share one GEMM that supports a transpose_b flag (no materialized weight_t buffer that can desync with tied embeddings like GPT-2's lm_head ↔ wte). Add a fused GELU epilogue for the c_fc Conv1D in the MLP and a fused bias+residual for c_proj. Consider a fused QKV split kernel for c_attn (3*hidden output) and a fused softmax-attention path; at minimum, ensure the lm_head matmul (which uses tied wte weights) reads the live weight tensor each forward.
